headline: NEWMONT SMASHES Q3 ESTIMATES — $2.20 EPS RECORD, $1.9B FREE CASH FLOW; RAISES 2026 AISC GUIDANCE TO $1,520/OZ
snippet: Newmont beat Q3 2026 EPS consensus by $0.25 with a record $2.20 adjusted EPS and $1.9 billion in free cash flow, also posting $4.0B adjusted EBITDA on 1.3M oz of gold output. The world's largest gold miner confirmed full-year production guidance of 5.3M oz but raised AISC guidance to $1,520/oz, with a Red Chris mine decision expected early 2027.

headline: PHOENIX TAILINGS BREAKS GROUND ON $375M RARE EARTH SEPARATION PLANT IN ROCHESTER, NY — 18,000 T/YEAR FEEDSTOCK, FULL OUTPUT 2028
snippet: Phoenix Tailings announced its Freedom Separation facility at Rochester's Eastman Business Park on Oct 20, backed by a $500M DOE conditional loan as part of the $1.2B Freedom Project. The plant will process 18,000+ tons of mined and recycled rare earth feedstock annually, producing 4,400+ tons of separated oxides at full capacity in 2028 — creating 90–200 direct US jobs.

headline: GOLD HOLDS AT $4,021 AHEAD OF OCT 28 FED MEETING — CPM GROUP: IT'S NOT THE RATE DECISION, IT'S THE INFLATION CREDIBILITY TEST
snippet: With markets pricing an 87% probability of a Fed hold on Oct 28, CPM Group argues the real market driver is whether investors trust the Fed to contain 3.7% CPI and 6.3% PPI. If that credibility erodes, real rates fall and gold benefits over the medium term — if it holds, the current $4,000 range may be a ceiling into Q1 2027.

headline: SSR MINING ACQUIRES ROXMORE FOR $464M ALL-CASH — CONVERSE'S 5.2MOZ NEVADA GOLD PROJECT CONSOLIDATES MARIGOLD COMPLEX
snippet: SSR Mining (TSXV: SSRM) will acquire Roxmore Resources at C$6.75 per share — a 27% premium — in a $464M all-cash deal, adding the Converse gold project with 2.2M oz indicated and 3M oz inferred directly adjacent to SSR's Marigold Complex in Nevada. Roxmore's other exploration assets spin off to a new company funded with US$10M cash; close expected Q4 2026.

headline: COPPER SLIDES TO 5-WEEK LOW AT $14,089/T AS LME INVENTORIES KEEP BUILDING — BHP CHILE LABOUR DEAL REMOVES KEY SUPPLY CATALYST
snippet: Three-month LME copper shed 1.8% to $14,089/t on Oct 22 as warehouse inventory inflows continued, erasing the supply premium that drove copper toward a September record near $14,875/t. A tentative labour deal at BHP's Chilean operations removed another near-term bullish catalyst; COMEX now trades about $80/t below LME, reversing the earlier tariff-fear premium.

headline: GOLD FIELDS REPORTEDLY EYEING NORTHERN STAR AS $4,100 GOLD SUPERCHARGES SECTOR TAKEOVER WAVE — Equinox/Orla $5.1B Set Benchmark
snippet: Gold Fields is reportedly weighing a takeover of Northern Star Resources as elevated gold prices above $4,100 accelerate a sector-wide consolidation. Gold made up more than 40% of mining M&A value in the first five months of 2026, with Equinox Gold's $5.1B Orla Mining deal setting the high-water mark — producers are buying ounces they can't replace organically.

headline: VULCAN ELEMENTS TEAMS WITH NORTH CAROLINA ON RARE EARTH MAGNETS — 10,000 MT/YEAR PLANT TARGETS US INDEPENDENCE FROM CHINA
snippet: Vulcan Elements announced a partnership with the North Carolina Collaboratory on Oct 20 to advance high-performance rare earth magnet technology, with a planned 10,000 metric ton per year magnet production facility in development. The deal pairs private capital with publicly funded university research as the US races to build a domestic magnet supply chain free from Chinese processing.

headline: ASX LITHIUM STOCKS IN FREEFALL: SUNRISE ENERGY METALS -16%, ELEVRA LITHIUM -10% AS BATTERY METALS ROUT DEEPENS
snippet: ASX lithium and battery metals stocks were among the session's worst performers on Oct 23, with Sunrise Energy Metals crashing over 16% and Elevra Lithium down 10%. Chinese lithium carbonate futures hit a near 10-month low this week after an EU–China deal on hybrid car exports worsened demand outlooks; CATL's Jianxiawo mine also remains closed pending environmental approval.

headline: STATE STREET CUTS GOLD BULL PROBABILITY TO 60% BUT HOLDS $4,750–$5,500/OZ TARGET FOR Q1 2027
snippet: State Street's October Monthly Gold Monitor maintains its $4,750–$5,500 per ounce gold target for Q1 2027 but lowers the base-case probability from 70% to 60%, citing dollar strength and uncertainty over the Fed's inflation management credibility. Gold has already pulled back roughly 3% from its October 9 close as markets position for the Oct 28 FOMC meeting.
